title: I made a multiplayer paintball game up to 8 players for team building meetings
author: NomadicHumanoid
selftext: Would love some testers and feedback.

comments.author: NomadicHumanoid
comments.body: I added in a single player and an adventure mode too.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/NomadicHumanoid please add some details about how you used AI to develop this. Saying you used AI isn't enough on its own. We're looking for the actual dev details. Rule 4 asks promotional posts to contribute by talking about the process and the actual development. We're trying to keep the sub from filling up with low quality game posts. If this doesn't get updated, it may be removed.

comments.author: Brokeoutangel1
comments.body: A controls screen would be awesome

replies.author: NomadicHumanoid
replies.body: Ahh yea. That’s a good point. I’ll add it!

comments.author: beeg_yoshe
comments.body: Feels like real paintball! (Died in 1 second)

comments.author: Maple-Syrup89
comments.body:
There is something about the controls that just isn't natural. Its WASD but also mouse aim. W should move you the way you aim. 


Currently, you have to juggle back and forth between W and S to go forward the way you want.

replies.author: NomadicHumanoid
replies.body: Thanks! I’ll test your rec out. I sort of built it to have the gun aim independent of movement so you can run around and shoot in a direction you aren’t facing like running straight and side firing. I see your point though and will try it out.
